posts.author: VHStapes
posts.body:
Hey everyone!
I am working on a game in RPG Maker MV that I would like to use 1-Bit/Monochrome/black and white pixel graphics for. I haven't had any trouble getting sprites to work using the template provided here, but I can't wrap my head around the tilesets. I want the default floor to be plain black and to be able to paint on little patches of grass, rocks, etc. Should I forgo trying to use the autotile stuff and just do everything using the second graphic layer?
It's hard for me to explain but I tried replacing the little grass patch in the tileset with my little 1-bit lines and they wouldn't draw. Trying to tackle the auto-walls seems really daunting as well.
Maybe I'm just looking for tips for making my own tileset in general, with a specific leaning towards 1-bit. Any tips or suggestions are greatly appreciated!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
No one can tell you what you did wrong without seeing what you drew.
But a black background is what MV will display by default where there isn't another color of pixel from a tile or event.

posts.author: Willibab
posts.body: You could go on Itch and find some free 1bit tileset and see how they did it. Most tileset packs ive downloaded were formatted for RPG Maker (Prolly not all of them though).

posts.author: kaukusaki
posts.body:
repeatable seamless 1 bit patterned tiles and textures is the term you're looking for. piixil has a cool set of tiles you can look at for ideas. kenney also made a 1bit platformer pack you can check out (both free on itch.io)
as for how to create the textures themselves, here's some software that helps you do it.
SEAMLESS PATERN GENERATOR
Seamless Pattern Generator
The Seamless Pattern Generator is an online tool that converts your image into a repeatable image when appended together, also known as a seamless pattern.
www.laurentvw.com
MATERIALIZE
Bounding Box Software - Materialize
boundingboxsoftware.com
IMGONLINE SEAMLESS TEXTURE GENERATOR
Make seamless texture online - IMG online
Make a seamless texture from photo online. Optionally you can choose the way to create a seamless texture, level of brightness transitions and to crop don't needed edges for best results.
www.imgonline.com.ua
GIMP
Rolling your own? GIMP has just the tool to instantly create seamless textures without fussing with any other downloads!
Simply open up your texture, click “Filters”, “Map”, and then select “Tile Seamless.”
Hope this helps!

posts.body: Thank you all for the responses (and so quickly!). Gonna dive into some of these itch.io sets and see if I can reverse engineer em!
